subject: Multi-product renewal: kickoff & burst onboarding
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holden <alex.holden@polarisai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-product renewal: kickoff & burst onboarding

Alex —

Thanks for taking the time to speak last week. Polaris has three active Redwood products on the platform (generation, embeddings, and private deployment for sensitive PCI workloads). As we head into your renewal window in September, I want to kick off a short renewal and expansion plan so we can lock in a smooth multi-product transition, discuss a potential multi-year term, and scope the burst onboarding you asked about for the holiday season.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm stakeholders across product, procurement, and security (names & emails)
- Target term (12 or 36 months) and priority for multi-product discounting
- Expected burst throughput (peak qps / token budget) and preferred region for capacity (us-west/us-east)
- QBR window: propose either Jul 12–14 or Jul 19–21 for an initial plan review

Attached: renewal_summary.pdf (current usage & forecast) and mutual_action_plan.xlsx (first pass).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm attendees and preferred QBR slot
2) We share a term amendment draft + pricing options for review
3) Schedule a 60-minute QBR to align CS/Eng/Procurement and agree on milestones

Happy to jump on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- renewal_summary.pdf (PDF)
- mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel)

From: Alex Holden <alex.holden@polarisai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <skhan@polarisai.com>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@polarisai.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-product renewal: kickoff & burst onboarding

Monica —

Thanks for the note and materials. We definitely want to get ahead of this. Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: Samira Khan (VP Product), Evan Chu (Procurement), and I’ll loop in Rita (Security) once dates are firm.
- Term: leaning toward 36 months if the economics and burst credits look reasonable.
- Burst: estimating a 3–4x increase for sustained 2–3 week peaks; primary region should be us-east.

Jul 12 or Jul 13 are good for the QBR — we prefer mornings ET. Please include pricing options and a draft term amendment so procurement can review ahead of the meeting.

Regards,
Alex Holden
Head of ML Platforms, Polaris AI
alex.holden@polarisai.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Polaris renewal kickoff — prep items

Team — quick internal note to align before we lock the QBR. Key points to cover so we’re synced:
- Agenda: usage forecast, burst runbook, term amendment, security checklist, milestones & mutual action plan
- Commercial asks to prioritize in the internal deck:
  * 36-month pricing tier with step-down credits in year 2 & 3
  * Burst credits model (pre-paid vs. on-demand credits) — Ben to recommend preferred public language
  * SLA uplift window for Private deployment (Polaris is sensitive due to PCI workloads)
- Technical: Karthik to prepare short runbook (5 slides) outlining autoscale behavior, region failover, and recommended KV cache sizing for bursts
- Legal/procurement: confirm deal_id DL-2026-1278 and draft term amendment (term_amend_draft.pdf). We’ll push a baseline to DocuSign the day after QBR if we get alignment

Ben — can you draft the lead commercial language and a negotiable discount band we can share with Evan? I’ll handle the MUTUAL ACTION PLAN and send the HubSpot deal link to Polaris.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pricing_options_v3.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx, term_amend_draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Polaris renewal kickoff — prep items

Ack — I’ll take the commercial lead. Draft guidance:
- Target list price uplift for burst capacity, but offer a 12–18% effective discount on committed spend for 36-month term (negotiable to 22% at exec approval).
- Offer 50% of estimated peak burst in prepaid credits with option to buy additional credits at a reduced rate during the first 12 months.
- Call out SLA uplift for Private deployment as a commercial concession (90-day review for performance gating).

I’ll have the draft language and a one-pager ready by EOD today. Also adding legal contact: Priya Natarajan (contracts) should be included for early redlines.

Ben
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
